measurement.random_change: Run 1: for each arm at seed 0 and each save, iid Gaussian matrices (one draw, seed null_seed(0, site), shared by every random state) each scaled to the library state's Frobenius norm at that matrix. Stage 1 (<key>_norm, the user's 'random change of matched norms'): read as it is. Stage 2 (<key>_kl, a stated departure, Fable's advice 2026-11-12): the same change times one factor b from E57's scale_search (match 1.5x, at most 6 evaluations) so its KL on the first 16 own rows is within 1.5x of the state's own KL there; its split is stage 1's times b (the least-squares split is linear in dW). The random gap of a pair and save = share(stage-2 random, A's rows) - share(stage-2 random, B's rows); stage 1's gap is reported beside it, not used for the band
measurement.blind_to: The share reads near 1 whenever K01 and K11 are both far under K00, whatever the update did: on p-9707d6ff E132 read 0.991-0.999 for random changes and updates alike. A gap inside the band says only that this share does not tell the sides apart beyond what rows and per-matrix size give a random change; it says nothing on how the update was made. The band's random change (stage 2) matches the state's KL and per-matrix norm profile, at 10-40x its norm: a weaker null than one at its norm, and A and B get separate factors, whose difference can itself make a random gap (both are reported)

description.band: Per pair and save: band = |random gap| + spread. None when the random gap is None
description.cell: From the three seed gaps and the band: 'unreadable' if under three gaps, any gap None or not finite, or the band None; 'beyond band' if every |gap| > band (strict) and all gaps share one sign; 'inside band' if |mean gap| <= band; else 'mixed'. Values rounded to 9 places before comparing
description.edge_cases_checked: Zero denominator (K00 - K11 = 0, as at W0): the share is nan, status 'nan' or 'unscored', the gap None, the cell unreadable. A state whose K00 - K11 is near 0 (under 0.05 nats a position): 'unscored', gap None, cell unreadable. A gap equal to the band: not beyond; a mean equal to the band: inside. Gaps of mixed sign all outside the band: never 'beyond band'; 'inside band' if their mean is within the band, else 'mixed' (checked on CPU 2026-11-12: [0.01, -0.012, 0.011] with band 0.003 reads 'inside band'). The do-nothing pair: gaps 0, inside any band. Empty or one-element pool: the seed set is fixed at three; fewer readable gaps is unreadable, never a smaller n. Band 0 cannot occur (spread > 0)
description.do_nothing_against_the_rule: A do-nothing state on both sides reads gap 0, 'inside band': the rule cannot read 'beyond band' for a change that does nothing
description.reports: The one figure (plot.py) and summary.json: per pair and save the seed gaps, the random gap, the band and the cell. Read as a description; the cell words are not reuse or new labels
